game.desc: Forza Motorsport 2 is a racing game for Xbox 360. There are three main game modes: Arcade, Career and Multiplayer. There are 47 tracks in total and over 300 cars from 45 different brands. The career mode allows you to complete over 300 races in 90 different events. Forza Motorsport 2 can also be played in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players on Xbox Live.
